subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: Should OpenClaw accept an explicitly marked native compaction result produced immediately after safety-timeout cancellation while the exact wrapper-owned settlement token remains open?
rationale: The mechanics are bounded and tested, but changing aborted work from always discarded to conditionally persisted is a session-state policy choice that source review cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Allow the exact timeout-owned settlement window and land once exact-head required checks are cleared.

options.title: Keep native commits fail-closed
options.body: Retain inner chunk partial-summary recovery and timeout guidance, but remove the AgentSession post-timeout acceptance path.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Pause until a slow third-party provider or full gateway run demonstrates the bounded commit path under realistic load.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Allow the exact timeout-owned settlement window and land once exact-head required checks are cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned reviewer and has the strongest recent history on the compaction timeout surface.
